components.name: NativeTitlebar
components.purpose: macOS-native window chrome with contextual title, command search and global Runtime indicator.

layout.description: Persistent native window chrome; search and health are secondary to current Work content.

accessibility.summary: Expose window identity, search and global Runtime health as separate accessible elements.

components.name: PrimarySidebar
components.purpose: Stable product navigation where Assistant and Projects are first-class.

layout.description: Stable scope navigation; collapse may change density but not information architecture.

accessibility.summary: Assistant, Projects and system destinations form one predictable navigation region.

components.name: ProjectContextBar
components.purpose: Canonical repository and worktree context without duplicate project state.

layout.description: Compact scope facts above project content.

accessibility.summary: Read repository, worktree and revision as contextual metadata rather than Work status.

components.name: WorkGraph
components.purpose: Read projection of Requirement roots, independent Work, decomposition and dependencies only; continuation/supersession belong to History.

layout.description: Navigable semantic graph with one selected Work and no progress percentages.

accessibility.summary: Expose Requirement root, Work nodes and dependency labels as a selectable outline; do not rely on graph geometry alone.

components.name: WorkDetailHeader
components.purpose: Selected Work identity and semantic state without progress percentage.

layout.description: The selected Work identity leads the detail hierarchy.

accessibility.summary: Announce the Work title before semantic state and optional relation context.

components.name: CurrentFocusCard
components.purpose: Bounded canonical Work continuation guidance without client-inferred activity or lifecycle state.

layout.description: One concise continuation block sourced from canonical Work detail; avoid dashboard metrics or inferred controller activity.

accessibility.summary: Read the canonical continuation prompt and next safe action when present.

components.name: PlanContextPanel
components.purpose: Descriptive Plan context and revision history; never a progress state machine.

layout.description: Secondary contextual panel that may collapse without hiding Work identity or action.

accessibility.summary: Expose Plan as optional descriptive context and revision history, not completion progress.

components.name: EvidencePanel
components.purpose: Files, checks, artifacts and receipts attributable to selected Work.

layout.description: Evidence is grouped by provenance and remains subordinate to current Work focus.

accessibility.summary: Expose changed files, checks, artifacts and receipts with text labels rather than color-only success cues.

components.name: RuntimeInspector
components.purpose: Global Runtime, Recovery, controller and connection facts separated from Work semantic state.

layout.description: Narrow mechanical-facts inspector that may collapse without changing Work semantics.

accessibility.summary: Announce mechanical health facts explicitly and never encode Work success or failure through them.

components.name: AgentComposer
components.purpose: Compact controller command composer for the current scope.

layout.description: Persistent command composer near the current Work content; one dominant send action.

accessibility.summary: Input identifies its current scope and exposes Send as an explicit button with keyboard shortcut as supplemental text.

components.name: AssistantWorkList
components.purpose: Forge-instance Work unrelated to a repository, grouped by current/history.

layout.description: Current and historical Assistant Work are grouped without inventing a Project container.

accessibility.summary: Expose current and historical Assistant Work as selectable lists with explicit group labels.

components.name: ConnectionList
components.purpose: Productized connection status, permissions and last-verified facts.

layout.description: Connection rows pair state with last-verified and permission details.

accessibility.summary: Read connection name, explicit state and last-verified time; do not rely on colored dots alone.

components.name: RecoverySurface
components.purpose: Standalone Recovery controls usable while Runtime is unavailable.

layout.description: Diagnosis context precedes bounded Recovery actions; destructive appearance is reserved for genuinely destructive operations.

accessibility.summary: Announce Runtime and Recovery states before actions; every action has text and is keyboard reachable.

components.name: HistoryTimeline
components.purpose: Bounded Work/Plan revision and continuation history without a second authority.

layout.description: Chronological history with text-first relation semantics.

accessibility.summary: Read chronological entries and selected revision without depending on spatial timeline geometry.

components.name: AutomaticContinuationPanel
components.purpose: Read-only projection of a Workflow Supervisor automatic-continuation task, including exact bound ChatGPT conversation, plus the explicit canonical action to move the same task to a fresh conversation.

layout.description: Task identity and current exact conversation are visible together; switch action is secondary and never mutates client-owned state as authority.

accessibility.summary: Announce task state, expose the bound conversation as a link, and provide an explicit Use new conversation button with its current availability.
